brief: remediation of W1-09 Combat core after critic scored 4/10 vs gate 7.0
plan: 1. hitstun composition: reaction states must span exactly `total` world frames (gb 40, staggers 32/44/64/96)
3. implement jump / two_hand / swap_right / swap_left / menu
4. animation: kill the double idle pose, land attack clips on the idle pose at phase 3, redistribute arc into the active window, cap peak tip speed to RI-CMB04 B
5. regenerate RI-CMB07 exemplar with real danger, >= 5 fights
6. close what is closable on RI-CMB05/06/09/11
findings: REPRODUCED baseline: guard break 46 f, regen 0.75/f at f123-125 (critic-guardbreak3.json run sprint_frames=600).

ROOT CAUSE of hitstun overrun: beginReaction() sets state at the impact frame with animFrame=0, then system.js early-returns for hitstop frames, so the state spans 1 (entry) + hitstop-1 (freeze) + total. Also guardBreakUntil = impactFrame+total which now EXPIRES BEFORE the state does, so tickResources' `hitstun` flag goes false while still in GUARD_BREAK -> full-rate regen. One cause, both symptoms.

ROOT CAUSE of the 1.42-2.54 m single-frame snap at the idle boundary: poseLocomotion() applies the idle_ready LoopClip AND THEN addPose(_idlePose = the same idle_ready archetype), so the idle rig pose is 2x idle_ready. The attack clips end near 1x idle, so the transition jumps a whole idle pose.

ROOT CAUSE of recovery sweeping more than active: every attack archetype has an overshoot key at phase ~2.35-2.5 (e.g. cut_diagonal upperarm_r.rz 8@2.0 -> 56@2.4 -> 10@3.0) so |d| through recovery exceeds the active band.
notes_for_successor: Do NOT re-litigate: (1) thin-weapon tunnelling ruled non-occurring, leave substeps at 4; (2) stamina-regen amendment EARNED, but bar at frame 366 reads 14.0 not 6.5.
